title: Brain perivascular macrophages regulate endothelial cell function via a cMAF-dependent transcriptional program in mouse and human
title_zh: cMAF 依赖的转录程序使小鼠与人脑周围血管巨噬细胞调控内皮细胞功能
abstract: Brain perivascular macrophages maintain brain physiology, yet their transcriptional regulators and functions in health and disease remain unclear. Using single-cell multi-omics and functional experiments, we identify cellular musculoaponeurotic fibrosarcoma oncogene (cMAF) as a key transcription factor for brain perivascular macrophages, and conditional deletion of cMAF disrupts their phenotype in vivo. Functionally, cMAF drives insulin-like growth factor-1 (IGF1) expression in perivascular macrophages, enabling communication with endothelial cells. Consistently, cMAF deletion in perivascular macrophages causes transcriptional alterations in cerebral arteries, affecting vascular functions. Notably, cMAF emerges as the main transcription factor for human perivascular macrophages, suggesting conservation of this transcriptional module. During Alzheimer's disease (AD), human perivascular macrophages upregulate cMAF and IGF1 to enhance communication with vascular cells, and this response is abrogated in APOE4 carriers. Lastly, we explore an uncharacterized polymorphism in cMAF, providing evidence that the cMAF program is protective against AD. Targeting cMAF in perivascular macrophages may offer new therapeutic strategies for neurodegenerative and cerebrovascular diseases.
abstract_zh: 脑周围巨噬细胞维持脑部生理功能，但其在健康与疾病状态下的转录调控因子及作用尚不清晰。我们结合单细胞多组学与功能实验，鉴定出细胞肌腱样纤维肉瘤基因（cMAF）为脑周围巨噬细胞的关键转录因子，条件性缺失cMAF会在体内扰乱其表型。功能上，cMAF在脑周围巨噬细胞中驱动胰岛素样生长因子-1（IGF1）表达，从而促进其与内皮细胞的通信。与此一致，cMAF在脑周围巨噬细胞中的缺失可引起大脑动脉转录组改变并影响血管功能。值得注意的是，cMAF在人体脑周围巨噬细胞中成为主要转录因子，提示该转录模块具有跨物种的保守性。阿尔茨海默病（AD）期间，人脑周围巨噬细胞上调cMAF和IGF1以增强与血管细胞的通讯，而该反应在APOE4携带者中减弱。最后，我们探索了一个此前未表征的cMAF多态性，提供了cMAF程序在AD中具有保护作用的证据。针对脑周围巨噬细胞中的cMAF可能为神经退行性和脑血管疾病提供新的治疗策略。
